headline: Indian IT services posted mixed revenue growth, with a few firms posting very strong gains while the sector‑wide outlook remains modest.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit grew at mid‑single digits for most firms, but Infosys and Wipro saw profit pressure. AI‑related revenue is a recurring theme, driving deal wins at several companies. Guidance remains cautious, with most firms targeting low‑single‑digit to mid‑single‑digit growth.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed materially to top‑line growth and deal wins across the cohort.

themes.title: Margin guidance and improvement
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin guidance, reflecting higher profitability expectations.

themes.title: Dividend payouts
themes.detail: Several companies announced or maintained interim dividends.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 15.6% YoY with solid profit expansion.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit rose only 6%.
